title: Nobody gives a shit how motivated you were.
hook: Nobody gives a shit how motivated you were.
caption:
WEEK 130.

Nobody gives a shit how motivated you were.

Did you show up?

When you were tired.
When life got ugly.
When progress stalled.
When your head wasn’t right.
When nobody was watching.

That’s where this was built.

Not in perfect weeks. Not with perfect circumstances. Just a ridiculous amount of days where quitting would’ve been easier—and I fucking trained anyway.

130 weeks of putting another brick on the pile.

Stronger. Leaner. Harder to kill.

And still not satisfied.

Keep fucking building.

Frank’s journey with us has been a really cool one to watch.

He started at 174.4 lbs and 25% body fat, and initially, the goal was pretty straightforward: get leaner while building a better overall physique.

And he did exactly that.

His DEXA scans eventually showed him at 20.2% body fat with 3.2 lbs of lean tissue added. From there, we kept pushing, and Frank eventually reached 149 lbs, his leanest weight of the entire process.

But getting as light as possible was never the end goal.

30+ years later, I still remember that moment.

In my early 20s, I wanted to be active, but even rec basketball left me struggling to catch my breath. I had activity-induced asthma, and I felt self-conscious in pretty much everything I wore.
